answers.A: Data aggregation helped ordinary Attention relative to its D0 fine-tune (+1.467 HOTA); JEV improved only +0.132 HOTA and IDSW rose +310. A1 remains below its original Attention initializer; J1 remains below strong Fixed/Threshold. CLOSED_LOOP_NOT_SUFFICIENT_FOR_CURRENT_JEV; no general claim that DAgger cannot work.
answers.B: Paired native prefixes had identical initial input/state SHA but diverged at TRAIN12/24/1, TRAIN13/225/0, TRAIN14/6/0. Direction differs by video. Full data intervention helped ordinary control more than JEV. Missing/UNKNOWN/Bank-only support and correlated person histories remain. Current targets certify first-past native-ID/person compatibility. Multiple native IDs can remain compatible with the same person, and neither the certificate nor local WHO correctness is a unique long-term Global ID or future safety guarantee. This is a supervision/decision-alignment limitation, not an established exclusive architecture cause.
answers.C: Keep Strong Fixed and honest frozen JEV evidence. The current new Recovery JEV module lacks support for deployment or continued scale-up. Direct JEV remains an auditable diagnostic, not a successful replacement.
answers.D: The sole direct lawful score/choice repair was executed. Against unchanged J1: HOTA +0.396, IDSW 1891->1093, but CVIDF1 83.511->82.406 and full-video identity-inconsistency duration 6957->7741 camera-frames. Lower IDSW does not establish stable identity benefit. Comparing repair to M0 also changes loss/readout/solver; only the matched direct M1/M2 isolates typed vs untyped variant, and M1 still loses to the stronger existing ordinary Attention.
answers.E: Best matched TRAIN16 reference: frozen Pair Threshold HOTA70.605/AssA71.106/CVIDF189.825/IDSW1002. Best new P2 model: ordinary Attention D1 HOTA68.892/AssA68.073/CVIDF188.038/IDSW1299. Direct JEV:67.052/64.476/82.406/1093. Same-GPU live-image costs are recorded separately; no cached FPS imputation.
answers.F: No new JEV exceeds Strong Fixed, Threshold or best ordinary Attention. Direct JEV exceeds the matched direct-Attention variant (HOTA63.097) but that variant is weaker than the original/P2 Attention and is not the strongest ordinary baseline.
answers.G: All new results are seed20261009, reused authorized TRAIN, and pre-exposed TRAIN16. No independent complete video, cross-seed reproduction, new source permission, or future safety qualification was established. DEV/TEST/sealed datasets were not newly used.
answers.H: Prefer the evidence-supported Strong Fixed/ordinary Threshold baseline and retain the stronger ordinary Attention as research control. Stop adding JEV Questions/Readers. Any next research scope should first resolve lawful action/identity-preservation supervision and independent validation; no new run is authorized by this final decision.
